description: Create a job listing for a company you own or administer. Saved as a draft unless publish is true; publishing counts toward your free listings and fails clearly when none are left. Requires the "employer" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token with the "employer" scope (create it at /app/api-keys/ → Custom → Employer). Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Acts as you: only the companies and listings you manage.

company_id.description: A company you own or administer (see list_my_listings → company.id).

publish.description: Default false = saved as a draft for you to review. true publishes now (counts toward your free listings).

name: post_job
